text: Hello and welcome
to Real Easy English from BBC Learning English.
zh: 收听BBC Learning English的Real Easy English节目。
zh_hant: 收聽BBC Learning English的Real Easy English節目。

text: Each week we have a real conversation.
zh: 每周我们都会有一段真实的对话。
zh_hant: 每週我們都會有一段真實的對話。

text: in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 用简单的英语帮助你们学习。
zh_hant: 用簡單的英語幫助你們學習。

text: I'm Phil.
And I'm Becca.
You can find a video version of this podcast on our website,
zh: 你可以在我们的网站上找到这个播客的视频版本,
zh_hant: 你可以在我們的網站上找到這個播客的影片版本,

text: along with a free worksheet,
subtitles, and a transcript.
That's at bbclearningenglish.com.
So, how are things, Becca?
Yeah, things are going really well, thank you, Phil.
We've just had a really lovely weekend.
zh: 我们刚过了一个非常愉快的周末。
zh_hant: 我們剛過了一個非常愉快的週末。

text: It's very sunny, very nice.
How are things for you?
Well, they're very good.
As you said, it was a very sunny weekend.
zh: 就像你说的，周末阳光很充足。
zh_hant: 就像你說的，週末陽光很充足。

text: And yeah, I love the sunshine.
I love it when the weather is a bit warmer.
zh: 我喜欢天气暖和一点的时候。
zh_hant: 我喜歡天氣暖和一點的時候。

text: And that's what we're going to be talking about today.
zh: 这就是我们今天要聊的内容。
zh_hant: 這就是我們今天要聊的內容。

text: We're going to be talking about hot weather and what you do to stay cool.
zh: 我们要聊聊炎热的天气，以及你如何保持凉爽。
zh_hant: 我們要聊聊炎熱的天氣，以及你如何保持涼爽。

text: Yeah, I love hot weather.
I'm very excited for summer to come here soon.
zh: 我很期待夏天快点到来。
zh_hant: 我很期待夏天快點到來。

text: I really enjoy eating ice cream when it is very hot.
zh: 天气很热的时候，我很喜欢吃冰淇淋。
zh_hant: 天氣很熱的時候，我很喜歡吃冰淇淋。

text: That helps me to stay cool.
Yeah.
Are there any other things?
Are there any activities that you do when the weather's hot?
zh: 天气热的时候，你会做哪些活动？
zh_hant: 天氣熱的時候，你會做哪些活動？

text: You mean apart from eating ice cream?
zh: 你的意思是除了吃冰淇淋？
zh_hant: 你的意思是除了吃冰淇淋？

text: Apart from eating ice cream, yeah.
I really don't like being hot when I'm in the city.
zh: 我在城市里真不喜欢太热的感觉,
zh_hant: 我在城市裡真不喜歡太熱的感覺,

text: because I feel like the heat kind of stays
zh: 因为我觉得热气好像散不出去,
zh_hant: 因為我覺得熱氣好像散不出去,

text: and it's very difficult to find a swimming pool,
or I love to go to the beach.
I think being in water can really help you cool down.
zh: 我觉得待在水里真的能帮你凉快下来。
zh_hant: 我覺得待在水裡真的能幫你涼快下來。

text: How about yourself,
when it's really hot, when we get a heat wave,
zh: 天气特别热的时候，比如热浪来袭的时候,
zh_hant: 天氣特別熱的時候，比如熱浪來襲的時候,

text: which is when you get a few days and it's
A long way above normal temperatures,
zh: 温度远高于正常水平的时候,
zh_hant: 溫度遠高於正常水平的時候,

text: then I like to put a paddling pool in the back garden,
zh: 我喜欢在后花园放一个戏水池,
zh_hant: 我喜歡在後花園放一個戲水池,

text: which is like a little swimming pool, and you just fill it with water and then jump in.
zh: 就像一个小游泳池，你只需装满水然后跳进去。
zh_hant: 就像一個小游泳池，你只需裝滿水然後跳進去。

text: Yeah, water can really help you cool off or cool down, to become cold.
zh: 嗯，水真的能帮你降降温，也就是变凉快。
zh_hant: 嗯，水真的能幫你降降溫，也就是變涼快。

text: So how do you make the most of hot weather, then?
zh: 那你怎样充分利用炎热的天气呢？
zh_hant: 那你怎樣充分利用炎熱的天氣呢？

text: Because you mentioned
we don't have many days
of very hot weather here in the UK.
zh: 有非常炎热的天气，在英国。
zh_hant: 有非常炎熱的天氣，在英國。

text: I spend a lot more time outside
zh: 我待在户外的时间多得多,
zh_hant: 我待在戶外的時間多得多,

text: than I do during the winter, for example.
If we've got nice warm weather and it's not raining,
zh: 如果天气温暖而且不下雨,
zh_hant: 如果天氣溫暖而且不下雨,

text: it's nice to be outside,
just to sit, spend some time reading, whatever,
zh: 就是坐着，花点时间看书什么的,
zh_hant: 就是坐著，花點時間看書什麼的,

text: cooking outside, having a barbecue,
eating outside.
You could sit in the garden and eat dinner outside.
zh: 你可以坐在花园里，在户外吃晚餐。
zh_hant: 你可以坐在花園裡，在戶外吃晚餐。

text: All of those things you can do in the summer when it's warm,
zh: 所有这些事情你都可以在夏天天气暖和的时候做,
zh_hant: 所有這些事情你都可以在夏天天氣暖和的時候做,

text: and of course when it's not raining.
But that sounds lovely.
Really making the most of those long, hot days.
zh: 真的充分利用了那些漫长的、炎热的日子。
zh_hant: 真的充分利用了那些漫長的、炎熱的日子。

text: Yeah.
So, to make the most of something
zh: 所以，make the most of something
zh_hant: 所以，make the most of something

text: is to do as much as you can within the time or the space
zh: 就是在你所在的时间或空间里尽可能多地做事。
zh_hant: 就是在你所在的時間或空間裡儘可能多地做事。

text: that you're in.
zh: 如果你在一个非常热的日子,
zh_hant: 如果你在一個非常熱的日子,

text: If it's a very hot day,
do you prefer to be outside
zh: 阳光下，还是待在室内靠近风扇
zh_hant: 陽光下，還是待在室內靠近風扇

text: in the sun or to be inside near a fan
or near the air conditioner?
OK.
Yeah.
I prefer to be outside.
zh: 我记得和朋友一起去度假的时候
zh_hant: 我記得和朋友一起去度假的時候

text: I remember going on holiday with my friends
and they wanted to stay inside shopping centers
where there was an air con,
an AC, but I wanted to be out and walking,
although it's very important that if you are outside
when it's very hot,
that you drink water and you find
places
where you can cool down.
It depends as well on the country as well,
zh: 我猜，因为在英格兰，夏天从来不会特别热。
zh_hant: 我猜，因為在英格蘭，夏天從來不會特別熱。

text: I guess, because in England, the summers are never Very hot.
zh: 但在世界其他地方，我猜可能相当危险。
zh_hant: 但在世界其他地方，我猜可能相當危險。

text: But in other parts of the world, I guess it can probably be quite dangerous.
Yes, yeah.
zh: 而且接着这一点说，因为不经常
zh_hant: 而且接著這一點說，因為不經常

text: And also adding on to that, because it isn't
very hot often
in the UK,
in England, we aren't very well
prepared for the heat.
zh: 所以，是的，如果你来英国玩,
zh_hant: 所以，是的，如果你來英國玩,

text: So, yeah, if you do come and visit the UK,
zh: 要知道在非常非常热的日子里，可能会很难
zh_hant: 要知道在非常非常熱的日子裡，可能會很難

text: just know that on a very, very hot day, it could be quite difficult
zh: 找到有风扇或空调的地方。
zh_hant: 找到有風扇或空調的地方。

text: to find an area that does have a fan or air conditioning.
zh: 好的，咱们复习一下词汇
zh_hant: 好的，咱們複習一下詞彙

text: OK, let's recap the vocabulary
that we heard during the conversation,
starting with heat wave.
Now, a heatwave
zh: 是一段天气非常炎热的时期。
zh_hant: 是一段天氣非常炎熱的時期。

text: is a period of time with very hot weather.
zh: 如果你make the most of something，就是尽可能享受它。
zh_hant: 如果你make the most of something，就是儘可能享受它。

text: If you make the most of something, you enjoy it as much as you can.
For example,
zh: 我充分利用炎热的日子
zh_hant: 我充分利用炎熱的日子

text: I make the most of hot days
by going outside for walks and getting an ice cream.
We also heard "cool down,"
which means to feel less hot.
zh: 所以，比如，天气真的很热的时候,
zh_hant: 所以，比如，天氣真的很熱的時候,

text: So, for example, when it's really hot,
zh: 我喜欢跳进戏水池来凉快一下。
zh_hant: 我喜歡跳進戲水池來涼快一下。

text: I like to cool down by jumping in a paddling pool.
zh: 我们也可以说“cool off”，在这个语境里意思一样。
zh_hant: 我們也可以說“cool off”，在這個語境裡意思一樣。

text: And we can also say "cool off," which means the same in this context.
And we had "air conditioning."
zh: 那是一台帮助你所处空间降温的机器。
zh_hant: 那是一臺幫助你所處空間降溫的機器。

text: That is a machine that helps the space that you're in.
zh: 可以是你的房子或者办公室。
zh_hant: 可以是你的房子或者辦公室。

text: So it could be your house or your work office.
zh: 它帮助那个空间感觉不那么热。
zh_hant: 它幫助那個空間感覺不那麼熱。

text: It helps that space feel less hot.
It helps it feel colder.
zh: 你可能会听到它被缩写成air con或AC。
zh_hant: 你可能會聽到它被縮寫成air con或AC。

text: You might hear it shortened to air con or AC.
zh: 这期Real Easy English就到这里了。
zh_hant: 這期Real Easy English就到這裡了。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 试试我们网站上的工作表，测试你学到的东西,
zh_hant: 試試我們網站上的工作表，測試你學到的東西,

text: Try the worksheet on our website to test what you've learned,
and that's at bbclearningenglish.com.
And we'll see you next week
zh: 带来另一段用简单英语进行的真实对话。
zh_hant: 帶來另一段用簡單英語進行的真實對話。

text: with another real conversation in Easy English.
But for now, it's goodbye.
Bye.
